title: Staccato — run log & quick metrics
content:
Quick personal scratchpad for short experimental runs. Goal: keep a compact, copy-pasteable table I can update during pairing sessions. Not a canonical benchmark — rough-and-ready numbers for iteration notes.

Run table (columns: run | date | model | quant | batch | seq | tokens | p50_ms | p95_ms | cost_per_1k | notes)
run00 | 2026-02-20 | rw-llama-13b-v1 | fp16 | 1 | 512 | 1900 | 22 | 48 | $0.63 | baseline single-token-stream test
run01 | 2026-02-21 | rw-llama-13b-q4 | q4_8 | 4 | 256 | 1400 | 18 | 39 | $0.21 | 4x batching reduced unit cost, p95 improved
run02 | 2026-02-23 | rw-llama-70b-v2 | fp16 | 1 | 1024 | 3200 | 95 | 210 | $2.80 | long-seq penalty, KV warm-up observed
run03 | 2026-02-25 | rw-llama-70b-q4 | q4_0 | 2 | 512 | 1600 | 58 | 132 | $0.98 | good trade for throughput/cost
run04 | 2026-03-02 | rw-mt-small | fp16 | 8 | 128 | 1100 | 11 | 25 | $0.07 | toy routing candidate for low-latency fallback

Quick observations:
- q4 variants cut cost ~3-4x vs fp16 on same HW for these seq lengths; p95 hit but still acceptable for non-SLA paths.
- batching >2 tends to improve cost but increases p50 for short requests. Trade-off depends on tail-target.
- 70B models show large warm-up penalty: first few requests after idle have 30-40% worse p95. Might be queueing or KV cache coldness.
- small model (rw-mt-small) is useful as a cold-start fallback for chat UIs — sub-25ms p50 on 8x batch.

Manual micro-checklist (for each run):
- [ ] note heap pressure / OOM warnings in logs
- [ ] validate logits shape vs expected (sanity)
- [ ] run small eval prompt set (5 prompts) to check quality regressions
- [ ] snapshot model/quant config + HW tag

Next experiments (short list):
1) run05: rw-llama-13b-q4, batch=2, seq=1024 — compare cost/latency vs run01 and run02 for medium sequences.
2) run06: 70b fp16 with pinned warm cache (30s keepalive) to isolate KV cold start effect.
3) run07: hybrid routing experiment — route <128 tokens to rw-mt-small, else to 13b-q4; measure user-visible latency on simulated 10k requests.

Open questions / to discuss with SRE:
- can we programmatically bump keepalive for models with high warm-up cost? (JIRA-1192)
- how to consistently measure cold vs warm p95 in CI? Need harness hooks.

Quick links:
- PR with batching tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/421
- infra note: confluence:infra/batching-guides

Notes to self (loose):
- when copying numbers to the shared doc, include HW label (A100-80GB vs H100-80GB) and whether inference GPU was in multi-tenant mode.
- include sample prompt length distribution when filing Dedicated capacity proposals.

End of scratchpad.
